name: walkorbit_tee_print
prompt: Five one-second shots joined by hard cuts. The man walks on the spot the whole time, always facing the same way; only the camera moves, round to his left, always high above looking down on his head, always at the same distance: shot 1 from the front, 2 front-left (mostly his front), 3 his left side, 4 back-left (mostly his back), 5 behind. Quick, short, even steps, three every second, never a run. Flat chroma-key blue background.
